purpose: 相談できる安心感を伝える架空の3人の装飾写真。実在の相談員や利用者ではない。
prompt_brief: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create an original professional group photograph for a Japanese early-career recruitment landing page. Three fictional Japanese adults aged 25-30, two women and one man, standing close together with approachable natural smiles and looking at the camera. One woman wears a light ivory jacket over a white blouse and navy trousers, another woman wears a pale blue blouse and beige trousers, the man wears a navy jacket over an open-collar white shirt with no tie and holds a slim navy folder. Realistic proportions, natural skin texture, individual faces, plausible hands, polished ordinary people, not glamorous models. Bright modern office lobby with pale walls, soft window light, subtle white and pale blue background. Landscape 3:2 composition, framed from head to upper thighs, the three people occupy the LEFT TWO THIRDS of the photograph as a compact group with all faces comfortably inside the top and left edges. Right third is bright almost white empty office background fading gently to white, for HTML typography that will be added separately. Keep the group close enough to crop to a near-square mobile picture without losing a person. Real photographic depth and soft daylight, welcoming, crisp commercial photography. No text, branding, logos, seals, badges, watermark, UI elements or statistics. These are fictional people, not identifiable real staff. Output only the photograph.
